name: comment-guard
description: Lists every comment line that lands in your working tree -- from an edit, a heredoc, a sed -i, or a git merge -- at the one moment when cutting it is still cheap, and hands back a four-part rule for deciding. Reads line comments, block comments and docstrings across 170 file types, ignores tool directives like noqa and go:generate, and stays silent on anything it cannot read. A second hook watches markdown, where every line is prose: it reports an edit that narrates the change rather than the thing, repeats what the file already says, grows a document without replacing anything, or adds to one already too long to read.
